# downsocial Snapchat Video Downloader
> Free online tool to download Snapchat Spotlight Videos, Public Stories, and MP3 audio clips without watermarks, logins, or creator notifications.

## Key Capabilities
- Snapchat Spotlight Video Downloader in original 1080p Full HD (60fps)
- Public Snapchat Story Saver (within active 24h window)
- Spotlight to MP3 audio converter (192kbps - 320kbps)
- 100% Anonymous: Zero notifications or screenshot alerts to creators
- Zero watermarks added, zero ads, zero accounts required
- Fast, secure cloud-powered extraction across iOS, Android, and PC
